svg.text: A143 — corner-first level-1 PAIR cover of k0_00 (the doubly-met BL corner): 11,772 D4_BL-canonical pair cells
Rows/columns of each block are the 36 position cells (ix + 6·iy) of the two conditioned squares; blocks are the (tilt of Q1, tilt of Q2) windows. Only the canonical half of each block is populated.

RED = P2 (max centre distance over the two boxes < 1 ⇒ the squares overlap); MID RED = P1 (K'(A) meets K'(B) ⇒ every realisation overlaps); DARK RED = P1s (A131 per-tilt-sub-bin refinement of P1); GREEN = survives.
BLUE RING = a Trump image realises this pair cell (canary). Geometry alone empties 9,638 of 11,772 = 81.9 %.
Trump's genuinely (unwidened) doubly-met BL corner is the pair cell {(0,4,0), (5,0,3)} (≡ {(0,4,5),(5,0,3)} under the θ ≡ θ+90° glue): an axis-aligned non-slot meeter with a 49.82° one.
Lemma K0-WIDEN's pad w = 0.02551 adds seven more Trump-occupied pair cells (flush neighbours that meet the widened but not the unwidened box): the canary is 9 pair cells, not 1.
